0.original: Xeerol Ja is eager to hear back from Halnaruk.

1.original: Xeerol Ja has tasked you with creating Ja Tiika juice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 230. Delivering items with a rating of 470 or more will earn greater rewards.

2.original: You deliver the Ja Tiika juice to Xeerol Ja. Speak with her again to learn about the next prototype your team will tackle.

24.original: Deliver Ja Tiika juice to Xeerol Ja.

48.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Into the Traverse.”

49.original: I'm glad to see you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I wish I could share the consensus on our last drink, but Halnaruk hasn't been back.

50.original: And yet, oddly enough, my shop has had an influx of <hex:021A020203>other<hex:021A020103> Moblins clamoring for fermented aloe juice. I hardly know what to think...

53.original: Aloe-rot juicymix is delicious! Incredibly flavortough!

54.original: One sip and Halnaruk's sluggyfeels melted away. Heavypack is now airylight!

55.original: Most days Halnaruk's parents are all achybacks and grumpywords. But after sipdrinking tasty aloe-rot, they are happy Mobbies both! Now we tell everymobbie to slurp Xeerol Ja's juicymix!

56.original: So you're to thank for all those customers! I'm glad to hear your parents are among those who benefited from our drink.

57.original: Stuffseeking is a solitary job. No one notices Halnaruk's sweatwork, and no one smiles for Halnaruk's bringfinds.

58.original: But mobbiefriends, findfellows, grumpyparents─everyone jumpskips for juicymix! Halnaruk wants to make more jumpskipping─wants to help make more juicymix!

59.original: It seems your concoction healed not only his aching back, but his aching soul as well!

60.original: Well then, now that our team is united, I say we move onto our next drink─a beverage for Hanuhanu.

61.original: I understand their diet consists mainly of reeds, which are beyond the purview of your average fruit stand.

62.original: But if we can determine how reeds benefit their health, we might craft a comparable juice. You've visited the Hanuhanu in Kozama'uka, haven't you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Did you learn anything about their diet while you were there?

64.original: Their reeds replenish their aeth─uh, energies.

65.original: Reeds seem to rejuvenate them, body and soul.

66.original: I'm sure I did at some point...

67.original: I see. Then a fruit rich in magical energies may be just what we need.

68.original: Not to worry─why don't you tell me what you do remember from Kozama'uka, and we'll figure it out together?

69.original: I see. It sounds like reeds may replenish the Hanuhanu's magical energies, so we should seek a fruit that's similarly imbued.

70.original: What about sparkleshiny Ja Tiika bananas in Yak T'el? Halnaruk has a featherfriend who says bananas are a Hanuhanu favorite!

71.original: Oh, you mean najool! That's a marvelous suggestion. Yak T'el has forests rich in magical energies, so its fruit must be as well. And if your friend vouches for it, all the better!

72.original: So long as we ensure that one glass of juice is as satisfying as a meal of reeds, our Hanuhanu customers will want for nothing.

73.original: Knowing your talents, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I'm sure you can make that happen─you always do!

75.original: Our first creation as a real team! We'll need Ja Tiika bananas in this juice, but the rest I leave to your discretion.

76.original: We need a juicymix that is both tastyfresh and energyrich. Halnaruk is eager to see how you'll craftymake it!

77.original: This consistency looks very promising! I daresay this is just the sort of juice we need.

78.original: Goodness gracious, this juice is thick! And what an aroma! Masterful mixing, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

79.original: This consistency looks very promising! Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─this should be all we need. Let's have one of our Hanuhanu customers sample it for us.

80.original: Goodness gracious, this juice is thick! And what an aroma! Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─this should be all we need. Let's have one of our Hanuhanu customers sample it for us.

81.original: So this is the Ja Tiika juice you spoke of! Full of energies, is it?

83.original: What a flavor! Rich and invigorating─why, I feel as though I've just gulped down a beakful of reeds!

84.original: I hope you'll make it a permanent addition to your menu. My friends will want a taste of this!

85.original: Powerjuice is a success! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> has a deft handyarm.

87.original: When thoughtmade together, our juicymixes are unstoppable!

88.original: Hear, hear! Your suggestion was invaluable for this one, Halnaruk. And for my part, it's been a delight to put my old studies to use in a tangible way.

89.original: Pfff... Kohhh... Halnaruk doesn't understand. Xeerol Ja has good thingknowings, so why not follow goaldream and be a chirurgeon?

90.original: Because I'm not good enough, that's why.

91.original: It's...well, it's a private matter I'd rather not speak of, all right?

92.original: Let's focus instead on our next juice. I've got something tricky in mind─a real challenge!

93.original: Halnaruk still doesn't understand, but will not presspry.

94.original: Xeerol Ja is overjoyed with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Hanuhanu Hydrator<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

95.original: A new quest continuing the story of Xeerol Ja Juicecraft is now available.
